classification.difficultyReason: Reduce a trigonometric equation to a cubic, reject an inadmissible root and find every angle in the stated interval.

content.prompt: Solve $6\cos^3x-18\cos^2x-4\cos x+3=0$ for $0\le x\le2\pi$. Give your answers in radians, correct to 2 decimal places.

answer.short:
$x\approx1.24,\ 2.08,\ 4.20,\ 5.04$ radians.

Put $t=\cos x$, solve the cubic numerically and retain only roots in $[-1,1]$.
answer.worked:
Put $t=\cos x$, so $-1\le t\le1$.

$$6t^3-18t^2-4t+3=0.$$

Solving the cubic numerically gives $t\approx-0.48620979,\ 0.32534187,\ 3.16086793$. Reject $3.16086793$ because $\cos x\le1$.

For $\cos x\approx0.32534187$:
$$\begin{align*}x&\approx\arccos(0.32534187)\text{ or }2\pi-\arccos(0.32534187)\\x&\approx1.23942309\text{ or }5.04376222.\end{align*}$$

For $\cos x\approx-0.48620979$:
$$\begin{align*}x&\approx\arccos(-0.48620979)\text{ or }2\pi-\arccos(-0.48620979)\\x&\approx2.07854341\text{ or }4.20464189.\end{align*}$$

Hence $x\approx1.24,\ 2.08,\ 4.20,\ 5.04$ radians, correct to 2 decimal places.
